name: Decision Gate
description: Decides by your rules: picks a model for new tasks, checks before automations run, and evaluates typed questions (noul, choice, score) over text, images, video, audio, and PDFs using Gemini Decision, OpenAI Decisions, or Jev.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants automatic model routing for new tasks, pre-run skip checks for automations/routines, or calibrated evaluation of typed questions (yes/no noul, single-select choice, rubric score) over text, images, video, audio, or PDFs.

list_rules.description: List all Decision Gate rules, the fallback model, the judge, and the models you can use (availableModels). Call this before adding or changing a rule.

save_rule.description: Add or change a rule (pass id to change). Supports noul (yes/no), choice (single-select), and score (rubric) question types. Top to bottom, the first that holds wins. Returns the saved rule and when it applies; tell the user.

delete_rule.description: Delete a rule. Confirm with the user which rule first.

set_fallback_model.description: Set the fallback model (and optionally switch the judge provider/model). Without a fallback model, this plugin’s model does not appear in the new task picker.

evaluate.description: Evaluate 1–1,000 typed questions (noul, choice, score) in parallel over shared multimodal input (text, image, video, audio, PDF) using Gemini Decision (gemini-decision-1), Jev, or OpenAI Decisions with calibrated probabilities and zero output tokens.
